ar.title: مكرونة بالجبن

steps.n1: يغلى مقدار كاف من الماء المضاف إليه الملح والخل، ثم توضع فيه المكرونة، ويترك الإناء مكشوفا حتى تنضج، ثم تصفى.
steps.n2: يحمر الثوم المفري في الزيت حتى يصفر لونه.
steps.n3: نضيف قطع الدجاج إلى الثوم ويقلبوا جيدا.
steps.n4: نضيف الجبن المطبوخ مع قليل من اللبن والقشدة والماء حتى تسيح الجبن ويسمك القوام.
steps.n5: تسكب الخلطة على المكرونة وتجمل بقطع الزيتون.

en.title: Pasta with Melted Cheese and Chicken Sauce

steps.n1: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, then add the pasta; leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
steps.n2: Sauté the minced garlic in oil until it turns golden.
steps.n3: Add the chicken pieces to the garlic and stir well.
steps.n4: Add the processed cheese along with a little milk, cream, and water until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens.
steps.n5: Pour the mixture over the pasta and garnish with olive pieces.

legacySteps: Boil a sufficient amount of water with added salt and vinegar, then add the pasta; leave the pot uncovered until cooked, then drain.
Sauté the minced garlic in oil until it turns golden.
Add the chicken pieces to the garlic and stir well.
Add the processed cheese along with a little milk, cream, and water until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens.
Pour the mixture over the pasta and garnish with olive pieces.
